title: AutoOps Activity Timeline
description: Everything that happened in this project inside a time window, in order: the automations that ran and what they returned, the ones that failed and whether they failed together, and the changes parked waiting for a human. Read-only. Vendor-agnostic — it reads the platform's own record, so it is the same evidence whether the estate is AWS, Azure, on-premises or all three.

inputs.label: Look back (hours)
inputs.help: How far back to read. Use the window around the incident — a wide window makes everything look related to everything.
